opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion of the appellees to dismiss the appeal herein is *538granted, and the appeal is dismissed for the want of a properly presented federal question. Godchaux Co. v. Estopinal, 251 U. S. 179; Rooker v. Fidelity Trust Co., 261 U. S. 114, 117; St. Louis & San Francisco R. Co. v. Shepherd, 240 U. S. 240, 241; Herndon v. Georgia, 295 U. S. 441.

Mr. Gustavus A. Rogers for appellant. Messrs. Harold H. Levin and Paxton Blair for appellees.
